g.text: PROHIBITED — Art. 5 bans emotion recognition systems in workplaces. The vendor's 'just analytics' label is irrelevant:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: what matters is what the system does (infers emotions) and where it operates (a workplace). The prohibition is not

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: conditional on whether the output is called a 'decision.' No compliance path exists.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: HIGH RISK — Annex III area 5 (essential services & benefits). The oversight is NOT sufficient: Art. 14 requires

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: genuine, meaningful oversight — caseworkers must be able to intervene or override before a decision issues, not merely

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: see the score. Public authority deployer must also carry out a FRIA.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Timing: compliance deadline extended to 2 Dec 2027 (Digital Omnibus).
